system.description:
60ft cone; roll d8 per creature (Reflex halves damage): 1 red 10d6 fire; 2 orange 10d6 acid; 3 yellow 10d6 lightning; 4 green Fortitude or die (success 10d6 poison); 5 blue Fortitude or turned to stone; 6 indigo Will or Blinded and Frightened for 1 minute; 7 violet Will or banished to another plane; 8 two rays (roll twice, reroll 8s).

Roll d8 for each creature first: red is fire, orange acid, yellow lightning, and green poison on a successful save.

Classes: Illusionist
system.saveEffect: Half damage (red, orange, yellow); the other colours as listed
